review.scope: PR5 retrospective audit only: fixed original 82-commit range, explicitly added decisions, independent hash-bound existing policy and ruling; detect extra findings without broadening publication exemptions
findings: BLOCKING: audit() validates each additional decision commit only as 40-hex, outside the original range, and descended from SOURCE; it never checks that every parent of each addition is SOURCE, an original-range commit, or another listed addition. An unlisted intermediate commit (or an unchecked second merge parent of TRUST, since pinned_policy binds only TRUST^) leaves its commit metadata, its deleted-before-tip blobs, and even content surviving unchanged into a listed addition's tree entirely unscanned, while the receipt still reports status PASS and claims full historical coverage. Add a fail-closed parent-closure check (rev-parse <pin>^@ subset of {SOURCE} ∪ original ∪ additions).

The ruling is not content-hash-pinned: the policy blob is verified against POLICY_SHA256 before exec, but evidence/decisions.md at TRUST is bound only by the SHA-1 commit id, with its SHA-256 self-reported into the receipt instead of verified against a pinned constant. The scope requires a hash-bound policy AND ruling; pin the expected decisions_sha256 and refuse on mismatch.

A historical .ipynb that parses as JSON but lacks 'cells' or has non-dict cells raises KeyError/TypeError/AttributeError inside the pinned policy's scan; scan_commits catches only (ValueError, UnicodeError), so one malformed notebook aborts the entire run and hides all remaining findings, contradicting the return-all-findings docstring (fail-closed, but incomplete reporting). Also json.JSONDecodeError is caught but mislabeled NON_UTF8_PUBLICATION by the [A-Z_]+ filter. Catch these structurally and emit a named finding (e.g., MALFORMED_NOTEBOOK_PUBLICATION).

Minor: a non-descendant additional commit fails via a bare subprocess.CalledProcessError from 'git merge-base --is-ancestor' rather than a named refusal code, inconsistent with the refusal-code discipline elsewhere; fail-closed, non-blocking.

Verified no exemption broadening: scan_history_blob receives TRUST as 'before', changing only the ancestry precondition for the grandfathered decisions/fixture branches; all exempted bytes remain pinned to exact SHA-256s of already-public content, the appended decisions.md remainder is still fully rescanned, and no new exemption names, hashes, or routes are introduced.

Verified fail-closed identity bindings and receipt hygiene: policy fetched from pinned SOURCE and executed only after SHA-256 verification (TRUSTED_POLICY_IDENTITY_MISMATCH otherwise); 82-commit count and TRUST membership enforced; receipts contain only path_sha256, object ids, blob SHA-256s, and named codes — no rejected content, raw paths, or subprocess output; non-UTF-8 paths/content collapse to NON_UTF8_PUBLICATION without leaking bytes.

Verified coverage mechanics within the original range and authority limits: full rev-list enumeration plus per-commit diff-tree --root -m with byte-exact tree membership covers merge side-branches, deleted intermediates, and empty-commit metadata; symlinks/gitlinks are flagged as NON_REGULAR_PUBLICATION; findings accumulate rather than stopping at first refusal; the RETROSPECTIVE_ONLY_NOT_PUBLICATION_OR_ACTIVATION scope and absence of any push/ratify path preserve existing approvals and activation gates. Source-only review: tests not run; pinned hashes not independently recomputed (all mismatches fail closed).
